same_history_scope: Each row uses its behavior policy's actual logged state and true means. Alternative recommendations do not change future states or data. Their average one-step regrets are not cumulative regret estimates for alternate adaptive policies.
tie_rule: first maximum action index, for stored float scores, widths, normalized float scores, and high-precision scores; argmax-set mismatches also counted
